name: What are the common amenity differences between new and older condos in South Florida?

mainEntity.name: What are the common amenity differences between new and older condos in South Florida?

acceptedAnswer.text: New development condos in South Florida, especially in areas like Aventura and Sunny Isles Beach, often feature expansive, resort-style amenities such as multiple pools, spas, fitness centers, private dining rooms, and concierge services, designed to cater to a luxury lifestyle. Older condos might have more basic amenities or require significant updates. The tradeoff is that these high-end amenities in new developments often come with higher HOA fees. Kelby Contreras can highlight these differences and help you find a property that aligns with your desired lifestyle and budget.
acceptedAnswer.description: New condos in South Florida often boast resort-style amenities like multiple pools and concierge services, while older ones may be more basic, impacting HOA fees.
